lore.summary: The episode explicitly introduces Kat and Johnny. Kat's questions elicit Johnny's convention experience; Tyler is not a participant.

speaker.basis: Speaker unresolved.

lore.summary: Johnny praises the prior-generation Tomb Raider reboot while distinguishing it from the original; the current title he is playing is not named precisely.

evidence.quote: the best Tomb Raider game by far

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Fallout play is framed as a temporary disappearance/hibernation, followed by a Wasteland-disease joke; not a real medical or relationship claim.

speaker.basis: Speaker unresolved.

lore.summary: Johnny reports his first Portland Retro Game Expo visit, while explicitly distinguishing it from his first gaming convention.

evidence.quote: Not my first time at a video game convention

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: He describes the expo as larger than expected, with vendors, free-play arcade, displays and panels. Unpriced stock at booths is a stated frustration.

evidence.quote: ask you on every single item

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: He reports buying about 40 SNES games, including cheap boxed sports games to fill set gaps, and about 50 games overall on the trip. These are different scopes, not contradictory totals.

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Johnny recalls roughly 30% sports titles on Genesis versus 28% on SNES while discussing the influence of marketing. These are unverified recalled figures, not measured pilot statistics.

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: He occasionally buys homebrews or well-made reproductions to support community work, while limiting their number. Counterfeit authenticity and disclosed repro collecting are distinct questions.

evidence.quote: support the community and keep that going

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: The ethics/preferences of reproductions are explicitly parked as a topic for another time. A later resolution has not yet been located.

evidence.quote: a topic for another time, how do you feel about repro’s

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Travel planning should leave space for boxed purchases; shipping is proposed as an alternative. Statements about carrier hours or security are historical advice requiring verification for a real trip.

evidence.quote: You want to be able to take stuff back with you

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: The hygiene advice becomes a joke about whether smell helps or hurts negotiating. Preserve as humor, not a buying tactic.

evidence.quote: Maybe maybe being stinky gets you better deals

speaker.basis: Speaker unresolved.

lore.summary: Negotiate rather than reflexively accepting an asking price, but do not abandon an already good deal you actually want in a crowded convention. These are conditional opinions, not universal pricing rules.

evidence.quote: If it’s already a good deal

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Gather a prospective bulk purchase before paying to preserve negotiating leverage; coordinate with the vendor and keep the pile clearly together.

evidence.quote: Gather your things and then pay all at once

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Another buyer tried to buy from Johnny's developing stack. The follow-on warning is not to fight over games.

evidence.quote: you should never fight over video games

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Advance tickets, food, water and suitable shoes are practical convention preparation ideas; the source does not establish current event policies.

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Kat contrasts catered fashion events with ordinary convention-counter food, sharpening the scope of Johnny's food complaint.

evidence.quote: because it’s fashion, it’s usually fabulous

speaker.basis: Speaker unresolved.

lore.summary: Local shows offer recurring collector relationships; a larger expo is a different day-long experience. Have a list and research prices before arrival.

evidence.quote: have a list. Do your research beforehand

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Budget separately for planned purchases and unexpected discoveries; choose trip scale and location deliberately.

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Johnny saw Alien Soldier for Mega Drive on sale but did not report buying it. He missed a boxed NES Advantage because another collector reached it first.

evidence.quote: Not that I was looking to buy it

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Johnny says he intends to return to the next Portland expo. This is a stated future plan, not evidence that the return occurred.

evidence.quote: I’ll be going to the next one

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: A prior Vegas event was a same-day buying trip with an empty carry-on; he contrasts this with the longer Portland vacation.

evidence.quote: really that was a buying trip for me

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Fit the convention into the trip's purpose: family vacation versus focused buying visit. Plan location, time and money together.

evidence.quote: depending on the scale of your trip

speaker.basis: Named introduction and dialogue continuity; untimed source has no reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: The ending contains an apparent repeated-intro outtake ending 'a snake, a snake'; do not label it a recurring bit.
